title: Second header row with all links
summary: On phones the header becomes two rows: the wordmark, then all four links (Dnešní hra, Archiv, Obsazení, Pravidla) in a row that starts on the page margin and scrolls sideways only on very narrow screens; the active page is underlined. At 390px all four fit. Desktop keeps one row.
tradeoffs: Every destination is one tap away with no extra UI, but the header grows by ~48px on every phone page, pushing the question and the board down.
